adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within `createAllCalendarEvents`, when iterating `event.destinationCalendar`, the branch where `destination.credentialId` is falsy calls `createEvent(c, event)` without passing an `externalId` (`destination.externalId`). After this diff, `EventManager` stores `externalCalendarId` from `result.externalId` (not from `evt.destinationCalendar`), so this path will produce references with `externalCalendarId: undefined`. Additionally, `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent` now selects the calendar via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` and falls back to `"primary"` when no match exists; with no `credentialId` on the destination entries, it will not match and will use `primary` even if a destination `externalId` exists. This is a concrete behavior regression visible in the diff.
